_note: QP + L1 (lambda = 1, rho = 10, dense Q; problems/qp_l1/problem.jl). Model: 64x64 ICNN (ELU, then softplus(5t)/5) + 100 learned Huber terms, fan_in initialisation, trained on ME/rho and grad ME/rho (scale_by_rho; the saved output layer and Huber weights are multiplied by rho): value + 5 * gradient MSE, Adam lr 1e-3 decaying by 0.9 every 200 epochs, batch 256, 5000 epochs, last-epoch weights. Data: julia --project=. experiments/qp_l1/data_gen_admm.jl --rho=10 --lambda=1 --gap=1 --keep=0.1 (exact sMEL-ADMM trajectories until gap <= 1%, a random 10% of the iterates; 40000/10000 samples from 5024/1264 instances). Used by experiments/qp_l1/table.jl (sLME-ADMM, with 0/1/2 exact correction steps at g_opt <= 1/0.1/0.01%).
